name: korean-humanities
description: Korean humanities research plugins for Claude Code - pick what you need: research methods (korean-humanities), gugyeol/old-Hangul recovery (gugyeol-decode), KCI citation networks (kci-citation-network), KCI Korean-studies trend corpora (kci-korean-studies-trends), and a completion-check harness for vibe-coding students (harness-lite).

plugins.name: korean-humanities
plugins.description: Korean humanities research methods for Claude Code - hanmun source criticism, hermeneutic argument planning, humanities peer review, academic English editing, and per-paper structure analysis notes. The research skills are prompt-only; the bundled CJK text helpers are optional, and one of them needs pip install regex.

plugins.name: gugyeol-decode
plugins.description: Recover gugyeol (口訣) characters and old Hangul in Korean academic PDFs/HWPX that extract as broken (cid:N) or PUA codepoints. Mapping tables bundled; optional pip install pymupdf for PDF input.

plugins.name: kci-citation-network
plugins.description: Self-serve KCI citation network builder for Korean humanities - give a keyword, collect citation edges via the KCI reference OpenAPI (free data.go.kr key), optionally render Obsidian notes. Stdlib-only scripts, no LLM calls.

plugins.name: kci-korean-studies-trends
plugins.description: Build your own year x field KCI corpus (no API key; rate-limited collection with a user-editable journal profile - see the robots notice in SKILL.md) and generate hallucination-resistant Korean-studies trend reports - topic clusters, representative-paper candidates, journal breakdowns. Stdlib-only, no LLM calls.

plugins.name: harness-lite
plugins.description: Student edition of the completion harness - blocks writes to originals, permanent deletes and kill-by-name, and checks every 'done' claim against a fresh verify receipt of the project's completion-condition contract (harness.contract.json). Needs Python 3.8+.
